title: Whispers in the Dark
description: A surreal night scene features a row of tall, dark wooden posts resembling an abstract fence or ruined structure in the foreground. Ethereal, ghostly faces formed from swirling smoke and mist rise above them against a deep black sky, with a vivid red streak cutting through the upper darkness.
